basic_details.job_title: ISI Project-Linked Persons Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Statistical Institute (ISI), Kolkata, West Bengal, has invited applications for 5 posts of Project-Linked Persons (Junior Research Assistants) under Advt No. No.PU/507/ADV/919. Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 1 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: 1st Class in MA in Computational Linguistics/Corpus Linguistics/Applied Linguistics
qualification.details: Qualification: 1st Class in MA in Computational Linguistics/Corpus Linguistics/Applied Linguistics Experience: Experience in NLP-related research and development work, knowledge of translation from Hindi to Bengali, Text Processing and Text Annotation, and knowledge of Bengali and Hindi grammar, lexicon, syntax, semantics, and discourse. Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on 31 December 2026) Age relaxation: SC As per rules, ST As per rules, OBC As per rules, Differently-abled As per rules | Other conditions: | Temporary basis on project titled 'Vidyaapati: Bidirectional Machine Translation Involving Bengali, Konkani, Maithili, Marathi, and Hindi' | Desirable: | Experience in working with translation software and NLP Toolkit Experience in evaluation of Hindi-Bengali parallel translation corpora Knowledge in project report preparation and research paper writing and presentation

how_to_apply: Send a cover letter to the designated email address along with the current resume in English.

Include name, passport size photograph, permanent/present address, email address, mobile no., parent's/spouse's name, date of birth, academic qualifications with percentage of marks, experience, and Aadhaar card no.
Email it on or before 1 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 1st Class in MA in Computational Linguistics/Corpus Linguistics/Applied Linguistics Experience: Experience in NLP-related research and development work, knowledge of translation from Hindi to Bengali, Text Processing and Text Annotation, and knowledge of Bengali and Hindi grammar, lexicon, syntax, semantics, and discourse. Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on 31 December 2026) Age relaxation: SC As per rules, ST As per rules, OBC As per rules, Differently-abled As per rules Other conditions: Temporary basis on project titled 'Vidyaapati: Bidirectional Machine Translation Involving Bengali, Konkani, Maithili, Marathi, and Hindi' Desirable: Experience in working with translation software and NLP Toolkit Experience in evaluation of Hindi-Bengali parallel translation corpora Knowledge in project report preparation and research paper writing and presentation

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ISI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: CVs with incomplete information or without supporting documents will be summarily rejected

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration of appointment is up to 31st March 2027 from the date of joining the project.

content_sections.heading: How Will ISI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on CV and qualifications Offline interview Eligible short-listed candidates will be called for an offline interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Cover letter Current resume in English Passport size photograph Academic qualifications certificates/testimonials starting from 10th class Experience certificates Aadhaar Card No. SC/ST/Differently abled status with self-attested scanned copies

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISI Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Send a cover letter to the designated email address along with the current resume in English. Include name, passport size photograph, permanent/present address, email address, mobile no., parent's/spouse's name, date of birth, academic qualifications with percentage of marks, experience, and Aadhaar card no. Email it on or before 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies for Project-Linked Persons (Junior Research Assistants).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 1 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on 31 December 2026). Relaxation: SC As per rules, ST As per rules, OBC As per rules, Differently-abled As per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 1st Class in MA in Computational Linguistics/Corpus Linguistics/Applied Linguistics.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Temporary basis on project titled 'Vidyaapati: Bidirectional Machine Translation Involving Bengali, Konkani, Maithili, Marathi, and Hindi'.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: CVs with incomplete information or without supporting documents will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on CV and qualifications. Offline interview. Eligible short-listed candidates will be called for an offline interview.

faq.answer: Duration of appointment is up to 31st March 2027 from the date of joining the project.
